title: Design System: NSU Bus Fare Calculator

display.purpose: Hero H1 only, bold white over footage.

figure.purpose: Fare total in the navy panel, tabular numerals.

title.purpose: Notice, route and FAQ row titles.

wordmark.purpose: Tool name in the nav bar; 0.9375rem is an intentional phone step.

body-sm.purpose: Row descriptions, help text, captions, footer links.

label-tile.purpose: Uppercase month and day-count labels in tiles, and the Unofficial tag; intentional 0.6875rem step.

label-micro.purpose: The uppercase 'Route' label in route number tiles; intentional 0.625rem step.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Every resting white card, the About message card and gallery photos.

shadows.name: overlay-menu
shadows.purpose: Phone menu sheet under the nav bar.

shadows.name: overlay-fare-bar
shadows.purpose: Phone fare bar docked to the bottom edge.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every transition that enters, presses or shades. A Tailwind theme token; bare transition utilities default to it at 160ms.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero H1 only; transform only, visible from the first frame. The one authored entrance.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: opacity 0 and translateY(6px) to rest, 280ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Content mounted inside a card (the suspended-days control). Reduced motion: 200ms linear fade.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every button and icon control on press. Reduced motion: no scale.

motion.name: chevron-turn
motion.purpose: Disclosure chevrons when a row opens.

motion.name: row-shade
motion.purpose: Chevron rows and tiles shade on hover.

motion.name: fare-bar
motion.purpose: Phone fare bar. Reduced motion: opacity only.

motion.name: hero-crossfade
motion.purpose: Hero clips crossfade in turn; reduced motion disables the transition.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The 500ms crossfade between hero clips only.

motion.name: menu-drop
motion.value: opacity 0 and translateY(-8px) to rest, 200ms ease-out in, 150ms out (transition with @starting-style)
motion.purpose: Phone menu sheet, which hangs from the nav bar. Reduced motion: opacity only.

motion.name: grow-open
motion.value: height 0 to auto (grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr, or ::details-content with interpolate-size), 220ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Route and FAQ rows, and the fare card's refund rows, so what sits below slides instead of jumping. Reduced motion: instant.

motion.name: sale-open
motion.value: scale(0.94) to 1 with one 12px cyan ring, 640ms ease-out, once
motion.purpose: The date tile of a ticket sale that opens while the page is open. Live change only, never on page load.

narrative.northStar: The NSU Notice Board, Played Straight
narrative.overview:
The page looks like something North South University itself would publish about its bus, built to the standard of northsouth.edu and no looser. It borrows the university's institutional grammar rather than inventing a product look: a two-tier navy header, bold white type over campus footage, grey bands with centred indigo section titles, cyan "notice" title bars over rows led by grey date tiles, yellow status tags, chevron list rows, a navy band holding a white message card, a grey photo band of the actual buses, and a campus-photo footer with a rounded cyan link panel.

Density is moderate and civic: generous section padding (64px on phones, 96px from 640px), white cards on grey bands, and lists that read like a notice board rather than a dashboard. Everything is set in one family, Geist, with hierarchy carried by weight and size. Depth is one soft navy-tinted card shadow; there is no layered glass and no ornament. Motion is deliberately NSU-quiet.

The site is unofficial and says so at every point the university's marks appear. At the owner's request it carries the North South University logo in the header and the seal in the footer and on the ticket card, and the "Unofficial" tag always sits beside the tool's name. Imagery is real: the hero plays three credited clips in turn (channel marks cropped out, the playing clip credited on screen), and the gallery and footer use the owner's photos of NSU buses. Provenance for every shipping raster and clip lives in the README's "Media and credits" table.
keyCharacteristics: northsouth.edu's institutional identity: deep navy, NSU blue, cyan notices, yellow status tags, indigo titles on grey bands.
One typeface (Geist) at bold and semibold weights; no display face, no mono in use.
Square buttons, rounded containers, circular icon controls.
One soft card shadow; tonal bands carry the rest of the depth.
Real, credited media only; the NSU logo and seal always travel with an "Unofficial" tag or disclaimer.
NSU-quiet motion: one headline rise, chevron turns, a 97% press, and nothing that loops except countdown digits and the hero footage.

rules.name: The Yellow Is Status Rule
rules.body: Status Yellow appears only as a status tag or the provisional-notice strip, always with navy text. It is never a button, a highlight, or decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Names Rule
rules.body: Components reference role names (primary, notice, tag, band, heading), never hex. Light and dark are two palettes behind the same names, and some roles invert (primary) rather than darken.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist sets everything. Hierarchy comes from weight and size, never from a second face.

rules.name: The Centred Title Rule
rules.body: A section opens with its centred indigo headline and at most one lede line. Nothing sits above the title.

rules.name: The One Card Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use the single card shadow or none. Stronger shadows belong only to elements that float over the page.

rules.name: The Square Button Rule
rules.body: A labelled button is square. Rounding belongs to containers and tiles; circles belong to icon-only controls.

rules.name: The NSU-Quiet Rule
rules.body: The hero headline's rise is the only authored entrance. Nothing loops except the countdown digits and the hero footage, and reduced motion keeps every state change while dropping the movement.

dos: Do open every section with a centred indigo headline on a white or grey band, alternating bands down the page.
Do lead dated rows with a grey date tile and mark status with a yellow tag carrying navy text.
Do keep labelled buttons square and at least 44px tall (56px for primary choices and hero actions).
Do put the "Unofficial" tag beside the tool's name wherever the NSU logo appears, and keep the footer's statement that the site is not run by North South University.
Do credit every clip and photo on screen or in the README's "Media and credits" table, and crop third-party channel marks out of footage.
Do shade photos behind text with navy gradients so white type holds its contrast.
Do reference colours by role name so both themes follow.
donts: Don't round labelled buttons or add a second card shadow to resting surfaces.
Don't use Status Yellow for anything but status.
Don't set text in Faint Grey; it is for decorative icons only.
Don't add a second typeface or put a label above a section title.
Don't add entrance animations beyond the hero headline's rise, or anything that loops besides the countdown and the footage.
Don't show the NSU logo or seal without the unofficial label or disclaimer nearby.
